segments.line: alarm goes off. You slap it.
The alarm clock is now in two pieces.
Here's how it works. Say today you can lift fifty kilos. About one heavy suitcase.
Tomorrow at six, a hundred. The day after, two hundred. Then four hundred. Eight hundred.
That's the trick with doubling. It starts slow, and then it explodes.
On day ten, you can lift fifty- one tonnes. More than a fully loaded truck.
fifty- two thousand tonnes. That's about the weight of the Titanic. That's real. Fifty kilos, doubled twenty times.
Now the rules. Only your strength doubles. Not your speed. Not your size.
You look exactly the same as you did last week.
And your bones, your skin, your tendons? Completely normal. Fourteen- year- old normal.
This is what if your strength doubled every day.
